mechanism.claim: Immutable flaw-related integration subjects in the official go-ethereum first-parent history reveal changing implementation-friction pressure. Recent research reports that newly revealed cryptocurrency technology flaws predict negative next-day returns. During elevated causal BTC variation, short when the completed UTC day's flaw-subject count exceeds the same weekday one week earlier and long when it is lower.
mechanism.side: daily flaw count D greater than D-7 maps short; lower maps long; equality is ineligible

external_support.paper: The Coevolution of Technology and Prices in Cryptocurrencies (2025)
external_support.reported_fact: The paper reports that a newly emerging technology flaw predicts a next-day cryptocurrency return decline without subsequent reversal.
external_support.inference_disclosure: Immutable integration-subject flaw pressure and transmission from Ethereum implementation activity to BTC are preregistered adaptations, not the paper's exact issue-event estimator.

mechanism.why_distinct: Exact repository scans found no go-ethereum, geth, technology-flaw, bug-pressure, or Ethereum implementation-commit trading clock. It uses no Bitcoin Core history, EIP/BIP specification blob, mutable GitHub issue or API state, market direction, flow, funding, OI, premium, prior event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: Only decisions whose completed prior-24-hour BTC variation ranks in the upper 35% are admitted.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: Conservative D+2 Ethereum implementation-history clocks and immutable flaw-subject counts are absent from Gross9.

features.authority: official ethereum/go-ethereum Git object graph at the sealed master tip
features.history: complete sealed-tip first-parent chain, oldest to newest; commit object and parent integrity verified; strict UTF-8 subject first line
features.effective_day: running maximum of normalized UTC committer calendar day, preventing backward committer timestamps from creating an earlier publication clock
features.flaw_grammar: case-insensitive ASCII token boundary match of exactly the frozen terms in the immutable first subject line; body, diff, paths, author identity, GitHub metadata, issues, PRs and current checkout excluded
features.daily_count: number of qualifying first-parent commits on each explicit UTC effective day, including zero-count days
features.availability: 12:00 UTC on D+2; live use is later of that floor and durable fetch/object verification
features.btc_variation: sqrt(sum squared log(close/open)) over 1,440 exact BTCUSDT 1m bars in [decision-24h,decision)
features.btc_variation_rank: strict-prior midrank versus at most 270 prior source-valid decisions; minimum 180; current excluded; rank >=0.65
features.missing: remote/default-branch/tip/object/schema/UTF-8 drift or missing/duplicate/nonpositive BTC bars rejects; no imputation

clock.decision: 12:00 UTC on effective commit day D+2
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT five-minute open 5 minutes after decision
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_premium: not signal inputs; exact funding only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: official immutable implementation history, published flaw-return evidence, conservative availability, dense daily source, and exact repository absence

stopping_rule: terminal first-failure sequence: source contract/support, Gross9 novelty, train/test/eval/final strict economics, then RV20 q90 audit; no repository, branch, tip, traversal, grammar, delay, lag, variation threshold, side, hold, clock, subset, source, or control repair
